usage: arb-engine [-h] [--version]
                  {scan,quote,fees,kelly,rh-event,bridge,maker,inplay,games,live,record,stats,backtest,kalshi} ...

Command line: ``python -m arb_engine <command>``.

scan     pull venues, merge events, print arbs / edges / max-buy prices
quote    one event or team: every venue's price, fee, all-in, fair value, max buy
fees     fee calculator for a venue
kelly    size a +EV (non-arb) position
kalshi   balance / positions / orders / order (dry-run unless --confirm)

positional arguments:
  {scan,quote,fees,kelly,rh-event,bridge,maker,inplay,games,live,record,stats,backtest,kalshi}
    scan                scan a sport across venues
    quote               show one event across venues (substring of key/title, e.g. PHI or
                        'Eagles')
    fees                fee calculator
    kelly               Kelly sizing for a +EV contract
    rh-event            analyse one Robinhood event page URL across venues (what the overlay
                        shows)
    bridge              local HTTP bridge for the browser overlay (127.0.0.1:8765)
    maker               rest Kalshi orders at arb-creating prices vs the cheapest hedge elsewhere;
                        alert on fills
    inplay              watch one game with your open lots: STEAL (below fair) and LOCK NOW (other
                        side cheap enough to guarantee profit)
    games               this week's NFL games from ESPN: status, score, situation, spread, model
                        P(home)
    live                price every live NFL game at once (model/market/ESPN fair, cheapest venue,
                        STEAL flags)
    record              scan on a schedule and append every event + quote to SQLite (arb frequency
                        by time-to-kickoff)
    stats               arb frequency / duration from a recorded SQLite file
    backtest            replay a finished NFL game play-by-play with public price history; score
                        model/ESPN/venues vs the outcome
    kalshi              authenticated Kalshi actions (demo env unless KALSHI_ENV=prod)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
